tier_reason: near miss: the hazard (a provisional pick file left on a genuine MDP-skip day) was present and the #144 / #145 controls held — nothing delivered, nothing scored; the controls' own remaining gaps are carried on I-066

contract.text: A genuine MDP skip day delivers nothing, is never locked for result polling and changes no streak state; a provisional <date>.json (3am preview or pre-lock candidate save) is never delivered, polled or scored on a skip day.

mechanism.text: hazard: a provisional pick was saved to <date>.json (the 3am preview or a projected-lineup check's candidate save), then confirmed lineups turned the day into a genuine MDP skip, leaving the file on disk — the I-066 precondition

control: the fallback honoured the standing skip (no delivery of the cached file), check-results and result polling score only a scoreable commit (is_scoreable_commit), and the end-of-day skip record was written

verified_recovered.how: 7/01: the stale provisional file was never delivered and was still result-less on 7/02 after the 01:00 scoring run

watchdog.trigger: after the 01:00 check-results run and after any result-polling write: a date whose pick file gained a result, or whose streak.json changed, while its decision.json is absent or scoreable=false and the pick file has no delivery record; separately, any delivery record on a date whose decision.json action is skip
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the final-skip date's pick file stays result-less, streak.json is unchanged by that date and no delivery exists
